recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, symmetrical portrait of a man with a bowl cut and retro-futuristic clothing sitting on a stool, framed by a massive, chaotic inferno. The subject holds a bunch of pink balloons, creating a sharp tonal contrast between the destructive background and the innocent prop.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a chaotic, high-energy fire background
Juxtaposition of pink balloons against orange and yellow flames
Oversized silhouette of wide-leg jeans anchoring the lower composition
Stoic, deadpan expression contrasting with the surrounding disaster
coreInvariants: Pink balloons as a primary prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, full-body seated pose, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, wide-leg jeans form a stable triangular base at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move up to the pink balloons, then outward to the swirling flames, finally settling on the heavy denim base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with fire textures, leaving only small dark gaps near the stool legs.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and yellows (fire) providing background energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo blue (denim) and purple/pink (jacket) providing subject definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright bubblegum pink (balloons) acting as a surreal focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across the board; the fire is blown out in highlights while the subject maintains deep shadows for a cut-out effect.

letterConstructionRules: High-contrast black and white box framing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family utilitarian sans-serif to mimic regulatory labeling.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, industrial look suitable for metadata overlays.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of a man with a bowl cut, wearing a purple and pink 90s windbreaker and extremely wide-leg flared blue jeans, sitting on a stool. He is holding a bunch of bright pink balloons. The entire background is a massive, raging inferno with detailed fire textures and sparks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small rectangular black and white advisory label in the bottom right corner using a bold, condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Are the balloons a distinct pink color?
Is the fire texture high-detail and filling the background?
Are the jeans visibly oversized and flared?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High-contrast lighting between subject and fire
Sharp focus on the subject's face and balloons
Chaotic, organic movement in the flame patterns
avoid: Centered text that obscures the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fire does not look like a flat backdrop but surrounds the subject.
Check that the pink of the balloons pops against the orange background.
Verify the bowl cut is distinct and sharp.
Confirm the wide-leg jeans create a heavy visual base.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central stoic figure + Absurdist prop + High-energy environmental disaster background + Retro fashion styling.
